hook: Your tuition is due. Your rupees are losing value. And your bank is *hiding the fee*.
pain: Two currencies. One deadline. Zero room for error.
agent: Paste the invoice. The agent takes it from there. It reads it. Checks your money. Pulls live rates. Compares *seventeen* providers. And builds the payment.
card: Real money. Real rails. Top up by card, through Stripe.
proposal: The agent proposes. Every term, on one card.
approve: And *nothing* moves until you say so.
sent: Approved. Straight into an Alipay account in China.
features: Every currency. Every bill. Your budget. Your credit in China.
secure: Two hundred and sixty nine tests. Thirty seven of them are *attacks*.
